_doc: Generated by game/tools/sprite_pipeline.gd (FLEET_PACK.md T-016). Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; null where the section gives the enemy no row), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.

anim._doc: T-083. Spec: research/fable-tickets.md section 1.6 (the 1.x tables are the spec; ENEMIES.md behavior sentences are frozen per D-040). One entry per table row, keyed by a snake_case state id; 'row' repeats the exact table row label. spec_frames are the section 1.6 frame names in table order; frames are the files that exist on disk, relative to this folder (T-016 produced TBD placeholders - you_NN maps 1:1 onto cycle_NN, see frame_map and DECISIONS D-T083-1/D-T083-2). Timings are in 60 Hz ticks and are binding; the attack frame lands on the tick the ring resolves. Effects are shader/transform effects on the billboard and never change body_rect.

params.band: 1.0 u tall translucent red band (not a ground decal), so its height is readable
params.note: shown on tick 90 = the tick the ring starts expanding (9 u/s to 14 u); the table names no hold tick for the you_04 frame - it is held until the sim leaves the attack state
run-cycle bob; 8 fps = 7-8 ticks per frame (alternating)
you_00 -> you_04 at 8 fps; 240 ticks (4.0 s) cooldown

params.feet_ring: a thin red ring at its feet shows the plane the shockwave will travel in
params.note: loop at 16 fps (double speed); 90 ticks (1.5 s)
